name: vello_encoding
responsibility: The data Vello encodes for a frame, with the buffer sizes Vello allocates for it
description: Vendored from vello_encoding 0.11.0 through [patch.crates-io] in the root Cargo.toml: BufferSizes::new allocates twice upstream's tiles and path commands, so a large board still draws (crates/vendor/README.md). Vello, which the browser painter runs, depends on it.
